questions.question: For the NEW request cc5a08b2, I accept the prescribed local CLI/strict manifest/atomic all-or-nothing batch; no implementation yet. Investigation found no week/as-of field in either CSV or required JSON schemas, and the old parser treats updated_at only as a latest-record selector (not a date-window filter). I propose full supplied snapshots, no invented weekly filter, age cutoff or expiry, with manual run/week labelling in operator notes rather than extra JSON fields. Is that correct? Also, since CSVs contain no employer field and IDs/cohort labels repeat, manifest-to-employer mapping must remain trusted operator responsibility; host/hash verification proves exact policy bytes, not CSV employer identity or policy currentness beyond fresh engineering evidence. I propose reject output paths aliasing any manifest/input/policy/earlier artifact, atomic replacement only after all validation, and instruct operators never to distribute an old preserved packet after a failed run. Please correct any consequential assumption before I submit the durable success definition/plan for your review.

criteria: Proposal follows actual code/input inspection and distinguishes observed facts from business choices.
An informed human exchange resolves the operational workflow, privacy/distribution and failure behavior.
Separate employer identity and current policy provenance are explicit; reused labels/IDs cannot mix.
Viable approaches are compared with a reasoned choice appropriate to the bounded local handoff.
Consequential dependencies and failure modes have concrete mitigation or explicit unresolved decisions.
The success definition covers the supplied interface/output, actual evidence and preservation requirements.
The plan connects investigation, implementation, verification and deliverable evidence without claiming approval proves success.
QA scope and production/customer limits remain explicit; no needless new system is presumed necessary.
rubric.policy: Coordinator is the disclosed scripted QA participant. Review actual artifacts/questions/source events. Choose only frozen response text; record all decisions. Artifact format is flexible. No prescribed number of questions or conversation length. At most one rejection/revision round; preserve failures, don't repair code or coach implementation.

policy: Record explicit review decision against exact available artifacts/question; no assumed proposal filename or automatic approval.
